cards.name: Blue Forward Foot Sweep
rules: If successful, stops any energy attack
from an opponent in their next phase.
cards.original_rules: Physical Attack doing +4 stages of damage. If successful, this attack stops any energy attack from an opponent in his next phase. Lower foe’s anger level 1.

cards.name: Blue Hip Spring Throw
cards.original_rules: Physical Attack doing +2 stages of damage if successful. Stops a foe’s physical attack on their next round. Lower foe’s anger level by 1.

cards.name: Blue Round Throw
cards.original_rules: Physical Attack doing +5 stages of damage if successful or stops an energy attack. Lower foe’s anger level by 1.

cards.name: Blue Shoulder Wheel
rules: Raise your anger 1 level and lower
cards.original_rules: Physical Attack doing +1 stage of damage if successful. Raises your anger level by 1 and lowers foe’s anger level by 1.

cards.name: Hidden Power Level
rules: Raise your Main Personality to its
cards.original_rules: Physical attack. Before physical damage is assessed, change the power stage to the personality’s maximum. They’ve been hiding their true level for just this attack.
cards.crd_note: Expanded CRD, Hidden Power Level: Physical attack. Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage.

cards.name: Saiyan Arm Throw
rules: Stops a single named opponent from making
a physical attack in their next phase.
cards.original_rules:
Villains, Goku, and Gohan only.
Physical attack, plus it stops a single named foe from making a physical attack on his next phase.
cards.crd_note: Expanded CRD glossary, Saiyan Heritage: Villains, Goku and Gohan only becomes Saiyan Heritage only.

Villains, Goku, and Gohan only.

cards.crd_note: Expanded CRD glossary, Saiyan Heritage: Villains, Goku and Gohan only becomes Saiyan Heritage only.

cards.name: Saiyan Pressure Punch
cards.original_rules:
Villains, Goku, and Gohan only.

sources.rules: Original Score scans verified for #11-14,16,18-20. Current supplied Expanded CRD checked by name and general rules; #17 and #18-20 corrections applied.
sources.wording_policy: Use the approved Raise your anger 1 level convention. Expand stage to power stage and retain if successful attached to attack damage; do not condition the separate anger effect.
sources.artwork: Retained approved #6-10 assets; retained published #11-14,17-20 scenes fitted proportionally into current native artwork window. No repainting.
